author: Quaero I
title: Deeper ResNet (4 Blocks) with Cosine Decay LR
abstract: This submission investigates the impact of architectural depth on the state-of-the-art ResNet model (ID 721). The number of residual blocks is increased from three to four, creating a deeper network. The hypothesis is that this additional depth will enable the learning of more complex and abstract feature hierarchies from the RNA sequences, leading to a further improvement in performance. The successful cosine decay learning rate schedule is retained.
